def nodeID(i, j):

def inRange(x, y):
    return 1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n

dx = [0, 0, -1, 1]
dy = [-1, 1, 0, 0]

class FlowNetwork:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.size = size
        self.cap = [[0]*(size) for _ in range(size)]
        self.flow = [[0]*(size) for _ in range(size)]
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(size)]
        self.deg = [0]*size
        self.height = [0]*size
        self.countH = [0]*(size)
        self.visited = [0]*size

    def addEdge(self, u, v, c):
        self.cap[u][v] += c
        if v not in self.adj[u]:
            self.adj[u].append(v)
            self.deg[u] += 1

    def sendFlow(self, u, flowIn, t):
        if u == t:
            return flowIn
        totalFlow = 0
        for v in self.adj[u]:
            residual = self.cap[u][v] - self.flow[u][v]
            if residual > 0 and self.height[u] == self.height[v] + 1:
                pushed = min(flowIn, residual)
                pushedFlow = self.sendFlow(v, pushed, t)
                if pushedFlow > 0:
                    self.flow[u][v] += pushedFlow
                    self.flow[v][u] -= pushedFlow
                    totalFlow += pushedFlow
                    flowIn -= pushedFlow
                    if flowIn == 0:
                        break
        if totalFlow == 0:
            minH = self.size
            for v in self.adj[u]:
                if self.cap[u][v] - self.flow[u][v] > 0:
                    minH = min(minH, self.height[v])
            self.countH[self.height[u]] -= 1
            if self.countH[self.height[u]] == 0:
                self.height[0] = self.size
            self.height[u] = minH + 1
            self.countH[self.height[u]] += 1
        return totalFlow

    def maxFlow(self, s, t):
        self.flow = [[0]*self.size for _ in range(self.size)]
        self.height = [0]*self.size
        self.countH = [0]*self.size
        for i in range(self.size):
            self.height[i] = 0
        self.countH[0] = self.size
        totalFlow = 0
        while self.height[s] < self.size:
            totalFlow += self.sendFlow(s, INF, t)
        return totalFlow
